# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_RECLAIM_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price that opens below VWAP but reclaims it with strong early volume indicates intraday bullish bias. This edge exists because early VWAP reclamation with above-average volume suggests institutional participation and can lead to a sustained intraday move, particularly in low-to-moderate volatility regimes where mean-reversion is less dominant.

## Mechanism

At market open, if price is below VWAP and within the first 30 minutes price closes above VWAP on a bar with volume > 1.5x the average volume of the first 5 minute bars, then enter long at the close of that bar. Exit: Chart-stop at the opening range low (defined as the low of the first 30-minute bar), initial target at 1.5R (risk = entry price - opening range low), with a runner trailed at 15% below the highest high since entry. Regime hints: Avoid when VIX > 25 or during major news windows; best in low-to-moderate volatility (VIX < 20) and during the first 90 minutes of the session.
